title: Spicy Gochujang Chicken Cassoulet
description: A unique fusion of Indian and French flavors, this spicy chicken cassoulet is a perfect blend of warm spices and bold gochujang sauce.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tbsp of ghee or oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the warm spices, French onion soup mix, and gochujang sauce. Stir well.
Add the cassoulet beans and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
